title: CSV column summer
brief:
Build a Python 3 stdlib command-line tool at src/csvsum.py (no third-party packages).

Usage: python3 src/csvsum.py <file.csv> <column>

- The first row of the CSV is a header. Match <column> exactly and case-sensitively.
- Print the sum of that column as one plain decimal number, for example 6.0.
- Treat an empty cell as 0. Values are ordinary decimal numbers without thousands separators.
- A missing file, a missing column, or a non-numeric value prints one line to stderr and exits 2.
- If the file has no data rows, the sum is 0.
